```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(glue)

# create manifest.json
manifest <- tibble(
  label = dir("networkjson/") |> str_remove(".json$"),
  file = paste0("networkjson/", dir("networkjson/"))
)
manifest2 <- read_csv("runs_config.csv") |>
  select(
    timestamp,
    N = num_agents,
    open = open_mindedness_level,
    M = max_memory_per_agent,
    t = num_time_steps,
    seed = random_seed,
    model = model_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = str_sub(timestamp, 3, nchar(timestamp) - 2),
    model = case_when(
      model == "google/gemini-2.0-flash-001" ~ "gemini",
      model == "openai/gpt-oss-20b" ~ "gpt",
      TRUE ~ model
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label = glue(
      "{timestamp}_A{N}_M{M}_t{t}_op{open}_seed{seed}_{model}"
    ) |>
      as.character()
  ) |>
  right_join(manifest)
write(toJSON(manifest, auto_unbox = TRUE), "manifest.json")
```

```{=html}
<div id="network-root">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="network-scoped.css">

<style>
  #network-root {
    height: calc(100vh - 80px); /* 60px = Quarto navbar, adjust if needed */
  }
</style>

<header class="header">

  <div class="controls">

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Repulsion between all nodes: Higher values push nodes further apart (Fruchterman-Reingold repulsive force).">SPREAD</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-spread" min="10" max="400" step="5" value="100">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-spread">100</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Preferred distance between connected nodes: The rest length of the spring pulling them together.">EDGE LENGTH</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-edgelen" min="10" max="100" step="2" value="10">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-edgelen">10</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="How strongly edges pull connected nodes toward each other: Higher values create tighter clusters.">ATTRACTION</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-attract" min="0" max="1" step="0.02" value="0.75">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-attract">0.75</span>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>
    
    <button class="btn" id="btn-reset">&#x21BA; Reset</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-freeze">&#x23F8; Freeze</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-labels">Labels off</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-size">Statement size by degree</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-defaults">Default Controls</button>

    <div class="divider"></div>

    <div class="legend">
      <div class="legend__item">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-agent)"></div>
        <span>Agents (<span id="count-agents">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="legend__item">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-stmt)"></div>
        <span>Statements (<span id="count-stmts">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>

    <select class="btn network-select" id="network-select" title="Load a network from the server">
      <option value="">&#x1F5A5; Select network&hellip;</option>
    </select>

    <label class="btn btn--file-label" title="Load a local JSON file from your computer">
      &#x23CF; Local JSON
      <input type="file" id="file-input" accept=".json" style="display:none">
    </label>

    <span class="loaded-filename" id="loaded-name"></span>

  </div>

</header>

<div class="canvas-wrapper" id="canvas-wrapper">
  <svg class="graph-svg" id="graph"></svg>

  <!-- Small cursor tooltip: shows on hover for statements and brief agent info -->
  <div class="cursor-tooltip" id="cursor-tooltip"></div>

  <!-- Worldview pane: opens on agent click, lists connected statements -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="worldview-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="worldview-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="worldview-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="worldview-list"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Statement pane: opens on statement click, lists connected agents -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="statement-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="statement-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="statement-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="statement-list"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="status-bar" id="status-bar">Initialising&hellip;</div>
</div>

<!-- Unconnected statements parking panel -->
<div class="parking-panel parking-panel--empty" id="parking-panel">
  <div class="parking-panel__title">&#x25CB; Unconnected statements</div>
  <div class="parking-panel__list"  id="parking-list"></div>
</div>

<style>
  /* Let Quarto's body/main have no extra padding */
  main.content { padding: 0 !important; }

  /* Make canvas-wrapper fill whatever remains below the header */
  #canvas-wrapper {
    height: calc(100vh - var(--quarto-navbar-height, 60px) - var(--header-height, 0px));
  }
</style>

<script>
  // Measure the actual .header height and set it as a CSS variable
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const h = document.querySelector('.header');
    if (h) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height', h.offsetHeight + 'px');
    }
  });
</script>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.8.5/d3.min.js"></script>
<script>
const DATA = { nodes: [], links: [] };

// ── Empty state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!DATA.nodes || DATA.nodes.length === 0) {
  document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent =
    "No network loaded \u2014 select one from the dropdown or use \u201C\u23CF Local JSON\u201D.";
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Safely extract string id from a D3 link endpoint (may be mutated to object)
function eid(x) { return (x !== null && typeof x === "object") ? x.id : x; }

// ── Build neighbour index from current DATA ───────────────────────
const degree     = {};
const neighbours = {};
let   nodeById   = {};

function buildIndex() {
  Object.keys(degree).forEach(k => delete degree[k]);
  Object.keys(neighbours).forEach(k => delete neighbours[k]);
  nodeById = {};
  DATA.nodes.forEach(n => {
    degree[n.id]     = 0;
    neighbours[n.id] = new Set();
    nodeById[n.id]   = n;
  });
  DATA.links.forEach(l => {
    // Use raw string ids from source/target — before D3 mutates them
    // We store original string ids in l._s / l._t at load time
    const s = l._s, t = l._t;
    if (s === undefined || t === undefined) return;
    degree[s] = (degree[s] || 0) + 1;
    degree[t] = (degree[t] || 0) + 1;
    neighbours[s].add(t);
    neighbours[t].add(s);
  });
}

// Tag each link with immutable string ids before D3 can mutate them
function tagLinks() {
  DATA.links.forEach(l => {
    l._s = eid(l.source);
    l._t = eid(l.target);
  });
}

if (DATA.nodes && DATA.nodes.length > 0) {
  tagLinks();
  buildIndex();
}

// ── Node radius ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
const AGENT_R      = 5;
const STMT_BASE_R  = 7;

function nodeR(d, byDeg) {
  if (d.type === "agent") return AGENT_R;   // agents always fixed size
  if (!byDeg) return STMT_BASE_R;
  // Area proportional to degree → radius proportional to sqrt(degree)
  const deg = degree[d.id] || 0;
  return deg === 0 ? STMT_BASE_R : Math.max(4, Math.min(Math.sqrt(deg) * 5, 30));
}

// ── DOM refs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const wrap          = document.getElementById("canvas-wrapper");
const cursorTip     = document.getElementById("cursor-tooltip");
const worldviewPane = document.getElementById("worldview-pane");
const worldviewTitle= document.getElementById("worldview-title");
const worldviewList = document.getElementById("worldview-list");
const statusBar     = document.getElementById("status-bar");
const parkingPanel  = document.getElementById("parking-panel");
const parkingList   = document.getElementById("parking-list");

// ── SVG setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const svg  = d3.select("#graph");
const root = svg.append("g");

svg.call(d3.zoom().scaleExtent([0.04, 10]).on("zoom", e => root.attr("transform", e.transform)))
   .on("dblclick.zoom", null);

const linkGroup = root.append("g");
const nodeGroup = root.append("g");

let linkSel, nodeSel, circles;

// ── Simulation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let sim;
let frozen    = false;
let labelsOn  = false;
let sizeByDeg = false;

function sv(id) { return +document.getElementById(id).value; }
function wh()   { return [wrap.clientWidth, wrap.clientHeight]; }

function buildSim() {
  const [W, H] = wh();
  if (sim) sim.stop();
  sim = d3.forceSimulation(DATA.nodes)
    .force("link",    d3.forceLink(DATA.links).id(d => d.id)
                        .distance(sv("sl-edgelen")).strength(sv("sl-attract")))
    .force("charge",  d3.forceManyBody().strength(-sv("sl-spread")))
    .force("center",  d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg) + 2))
    .on("tick", onTick)
    .on("end",  () => { statusBar.textContent = "Converged."; });
  statusBar.textContent = "Simulating\u2026";
}

function onTick() {
  linkSel.attr("x1", d => d.source.x).attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
         .attr("x2", d => d.target.x).attr("y2", d => d.target.y);
  nodeSel.attr("transform", d => "translate(" + d.x + "," + d.y + ")");
}

// ── Draw / redraw ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function updateLegend() {
  const nAgents = DATA.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "agent").length;
  const nStmts  = DATA.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "statement").length;
  document.getElementById("count-agents").textContent = nAgents;
  document.getElementById("count-stmts").textContent  = nStmts;
}

function updateParking() {
  const unconnected = DATA.nodes.filter(n => n.type === "statement" && degree[n.id] === 0);
  nodeSel.classed("node--unconnected", d => d.type === "statement" && degree[d.id] === 0);
  if (unconnected.length > 0) {
    parkingPanel.classList.remove("parking-panel--empty");
    parkingList.innerHTML = unconnected
      .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, undefined, {numeric: true}))
      .map(n => '<div class="parking-panel__item">' + n.label + '</div>')
      .join("");
  } else {
    parkingPanel.classList.add("parking-panel--empty");
    parkingList.innerHTML = "";
  }
}

function redraw() {
  linkGroup.selectAll("line").remove();
  nodeGroup.selectAll("g").remove();

  linkSel = linkGroup.selectAll("line")
    .data(DATA.links)
    .join("line")
    .attr("class", "edge");

  // Key function uses the stable _s/_t tags, not the (possibly mutated) source/target
  nodeSel = nodeGroup.selectAll("g")
    .data(DATA.nodes, d => d.id)
    .join("g")
    .attr("class", "node")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          d._didDrag = false;
          d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y;
        }
      })
      .on("drag",  (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          if (!d._didDrag) {
            sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
            d._didDrag = true;
          }
          d.fx = e.x; d.fy = e.y;
        }
      })
      .on("end",   (e,d) => {
        if(!frozen) {
          if (!e.active) sim.alphaTarget(0);
          d.fx = null; d.fy = null;
          delete d._didDrag;
        }
      })
    )
    .on("mouseover", onHover)
    .on("mousemove", onMove)
    .on("mouseout",  onOut)
    .on("click",     onClick);

  circles = nodeSel.append("circle")
    .attr("class",  "node__circle")
    .attr("r",      d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg))
    .attr("fill",   d => d.type === "agent" ? "var(--color-agent)" : "var(--color-stmt)")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.type === "agent" ? "var(--color-agent-stroke)" : "var(--color-stmt-stroke)");

  nodeSel.append("text")
    .attr("class", "node__label")
    .attr("dy", d => d.type === "agent" ? -8 : -10)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .text(d => d.label);

  if (!labelsOn) nodeSel.classed("node--labels-hidden", true);

  // Set initial button state for labels
  const btnLabels = document.getElementById("btn-labels");
  btnLabels.textContent = labelsOn ? "Labels off" : "Labels on";
  btnLabels.classList.toggle("btn--active", !labelsOn);

  updateParking();
  updateLegend();
}

// ── Initial draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (DATA.nodes && DATA.nodes.length > 0) {
  redraw();
  buildSim();
}

// ── Sliders ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function bindSlider(slId, vlId, dec, fn) {
  const sl = document.getElementById(slId);
  const vl = document.getElementById(vlId);
  sl.addEventListener("input", () => { vl.textContent = (+sl.value).toFixed(dec); fn(+sl.value); });
}
bindSlider("sl-spread",  "vl-spread",  0, v => {
  sim.force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-v)); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });
bindSlider("sl-edgelen", "vl-edgelen", 0, v => {
  sim.force("link").distance(v); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });
bindSlider("sl-attract", "vl-attract", 2, v => {
  sim.force("link").strength(v); sim.alpha(0.4).restart(); });

// ── Buttons ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById("btn-reset").addEventListener("click", () => {
  frozen = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-freeze").textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze";
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.x=undefined; d.y=undefined; d.vx=0; d.vy=0; d.fx=null; d.fy=null; });
  buildSim();
  sim.alpha(1).restart();
});

document.getElementById("btn-freeze").addEventListener("click", function() {
  frozen = !frozen;
  if (frozen) { sim.stop(); this.textContent = "\u25B6 Unfreeze"; }
  else        { sim.alpha(0.3).restart(); this.textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze"; }
});

document.getElementById("btn-labels").addEventListener("click", function() {
  labelsOn = !labelsOn;
  nodeSel.classed("node--labels-hidden", !labelsOn);
  this.textContent = labelsOn ? "Labels off" : "Labels on";
  this.classList.toggle("btn--active", !labelsOn);
});

document.getElementById("btn-size").addEventListener("click", function() {
  sizeByDeg = !sizeByDeg;
  this.classList.toggle("btn--active", sizeByDeg);
  this.textContent = sizeByDeg ? "Stmt size: uniform" : "Stmt size by degree";
  // Only statement circles change; agents stay fixed
  circles.filter(d => d.type === "statement")
    .transition().duration(400)
    .attr("r", d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg));
  sim.force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => nodeR(d, sizeByDeg) + 2));
  sim.alpha(0.15).restart();
});

document.getElementById("btn-defaults").addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById("sl-spread").value = 100;
  document.getElementById("vl-spread").textContent = "100";
  document.getElementById("sl-edgelen").value = 10;
  document.getElementById("vl-edgelen").textContent = "10";
  document.getElementById("sl-attract").value = 0.75;
  document.getElementById("vl-attract").textContent = "0.75";
  // Update simulation with default values
  sim.force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-100));
  sim.force("link").distance(10).strength(0.75);
  sim.alpha(0.4).restart();
});

// ── Hover ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function onHover(event, d) {
  const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
         .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));

  if (d.type === "agent") {
    const count = (neighbours[d.id] || new Set()).size;
    cursorTip.textContent = d.label + " \u00B7 " + count + " statement" + (count !== 1 ? "s" : "");
  } else {
    const deg = (neighbours[d.id] || new Set()).size;
    cursorTip.textContent = d.label
      + (d.topic ? " \u00B7 " + d.topic : "")
      + " \u00B7 " + deg + " agent" + (deg !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    // Highlight matching row in open worldview pane
    worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el =>
      el.classList.toggle("worldview-pane__item--highlighted", el.dataset.id === d.id)
    );
  }
  cursorTip.style.display = "block";
}

function onMove(event) {
  const r  = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tw = cursorTip.offsetWidth;
  const th = cursorTip.offsetHeight;
  let x = event.clientX - r.left + 16;
  let y = event.clientY - r.top  - 10;
  if (x + tw > wrap.clientWidth  - 10) x -= tw + 32;
  if (y + th > wrap.clientHeight - 10) y  = wrap.clientHeight - th - 10;
  cursorTip.style.left = x + "px";
  cursorTip.style.top  = y + "px";
}

function onOut() {
  cursorTip.style.display = "none";
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el =>
    el.classList.remove("worldview-pane__item--highlighted")
  );
}

// ── Click: worldview for agents, info panel for statements ────────
function openWorldview(d) {
  const stmts = Array.from(neighbours[d.id] || [])
    .map(id => nodeById[id])
    .filter(n => n && n.type === "statement")
    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, undefined, {numeric: true}));

  worldviewTitle.textContent = d.label + "\u2019s Worldview";
  worldviewList.innerHTML = stmts.length === 0
    ? '<div class="worldview-pane__empty">No connections</div>'
    : stmts.map(n => {
        const sub = n.topic
          ? ' <span class="worldview-pane__item-sub">' + n.topic + '</span>' : '';
        return '<div class="worldview-pane__item" data-id="' + n.id + '">'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-id">' + n.id + '</span>'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-text">' + n.label + sub + '</span>'
             + '</div>';
      }).join("");

  // Hover over agent title highlights agent and all connected statements
  worldviewTitle.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
    const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
           .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
  });
  worldviewTitle.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  });

  // Hover over item in pane highlights that statement node in graph
  worldviewList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      const sid = el.dataset.id;
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n => n.id === sid || n.id === d.id)
             .classed("node--dimmed",      n => n.id !== sid && n.id !== d.id);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l =>
        (l._s === d.id && l._t === sid) || (l._t === d.id && l._s === sid));
    });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
    });
  });

  worldviewPane.classList.add("worldview-pane--visible");
}

function openStatementPane(d) {
  const agents = Array.from(neighbours[d.id] || [])
    .map(id => nodeById[id])
    .filter(n => n && n.type === "agent")
    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id, undefined, {numeric: true}));

  document.getElementById("statement-title").textContent = d.label + "\u2019s Agents";
  const statementList = document.getElementById("statement-list");
  statementList.innerHTML = agents.length === 0
    ? '<div class="worldview-pane__empty">No connections</div>'
    : agents.map(n => {
        return '<div class="worldview-pane__item" data-id="' + n.id + '">'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-id">' + n.id + '</span>'
             + '<span class="worldview-pane__item-text">' + n.label + '</span>'
             + '</div>';
      }).join("");

  // Hover over statement title highlights statement and all connected agents
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("statement-title");
  titleEl.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
    const nb = new Set([d.id, ...(neighbours[d.id] || [])]);
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n =>  nb.has(n.id))
           .classed("node--dimmed",      n => !nb.has(n.id));
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l => l._s === d.id || l._t === d.id);
  });
  titleEl.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
    nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
    linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  });

  // Hover over item in pane highlights that agent node in graph
  statementList.querySelectorAll(".worldview-pane__item").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
      const aid = el.dataset.id;
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", n => n.id === aid || n.id === d.id)
             .classed("node--dimmed",      n => n.id !== aid && n.id !== d.id);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", l =>
        (l._s === d.id && l._t === aid) || (l._t === d.id && l._s === aid));
    });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
      linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
    });
  });

  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.add("worldview-pane--visible");
}

function onClick(event, d) {
  event.stopPropagation();
  if (d.type === "agent") {
    document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
    openWorldview(d);
  } else {
    worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
    openStatementPane(d);
  }
}

document.getElementById("worldview-close").addEventListener("click", e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  // Unlock all nodes when closing panel
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; });
});
document.getElementById("statement-close").addEventListener("click", e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  nodeSel.classed("node--highlighted", false).classed("node--dimmed", false);
  linkSel.classed("edge--highlighted", false);
  // Unlock all nodes when closing panel
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.fx = null; d.fy = null; });
});

// ── Server network loader (manifest.json) ────────────────────────
// Fetches manifest.json on load. 
const networkSelect = document.getElementById("network-select");

fetch("manifest.json")
  .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("No manifest"); return r.json(); })
  .then(manifest => {
    manifest.forEach(entry => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value       = entry.file;
      opt.textContent = entry.label;
      networkSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });
    networkSelect.style.display = "";  // show only if manifest loaded
    // Auto-load the first entry
    if (manifest.length > 0) {
      const first = manifest[0];
      networkSelect.value = first.file;
      document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Loading\u2026";
      fetch(first.file)
        .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
        .then(data => loadData(data, first.file.split("/").pop()))
        .catch(err => {
          document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Failed to load: " + err.message;
        });
    }
  })
  .catch(() => {
    networkSelect.style.display = "none";  // hide if no server / no manifest
  });

networkSelect.addEventListener("change", function() {
  const url = this.value;
  if (!url) return;
  document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Loading\u2026";
  fetch(url)
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(data => {
      loadData(data, url.split("/").pop());
      this.blur();
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Failed to load: " + err.message;
      this.value = "";
    });
});

// ── Local file loader ─────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById("file-input").addEventListener("change", function() {
  const file = this.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = e => {
    try {
      loadData(JSON.parse(e.target.result), file.name);
    } catch(err) {
      alert("Could not parse JSON: " + err.message);
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
  this.value = "";
});

function loadData(newData, filename) {
  DATA.nodes = newData.nodes;
  DATA.links = newData.links;
  tagLinks();
  buildIndex();
  // Show filename, reset whichever loader wasn't used
  document.getElementById("loaded-name").textContent = filename.replace(/\.json$/i, "");
  worldviewPane.classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  document.getElementById("statement-pane").classList.remove("worldview-pane--visible");
  frozen = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-freeze").textContent = "\u23F8 Freeze";
  DATA.nodes.forEach(d => { d.x=undefined; d.y=undefined; d.vx=0; d.vy=0; d.fx=null; d.fy=null; });
  redraw();
  buildSim();
  sim.alpha(1).restart();
}

// ── Resize ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  if (!frozen) {
    const [W, H] = wh();
    sim.force("center", d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2));
    sim.alpha(0.2).restart();
  }
});
</script>
</div>
```
